name: Onanie Shoujo to Hentai Kyoushi no Koufuku na Ketsumatsu
original_name: オナニー少女と変態教師の幸福な結末
source:
School teacher Satou grumbled as he walked the halls of school.
He heard the distinct moans of pleasure emanating from the girls' toilet.

Nadeshiko Hoshino --- the pretty student council president.
Kanako Yoshino --- a very well-mannered young lady.

Satou felt his stomach drop with undeniable lust.
He couldn't help but take advantage of the situation, and interrupted them.

"I'll protect your secret..." he proposed, "You have to do whatever I say.
Do you think you can keep pace with my desires?"

他听到女厕所里传来明显的愉悦的呻吟声。

星野抚子——漂亮的学生会长。
吉野加奈子——一位非常有礼貌的小姐。

佐藤感到胃部因不可否认的欲望而下降。
他忍不住趁势打断了他们。

“我会保护你的秘密……”他提议道，“我说什么你就得做什么。
你觉得你能跟得上我的欲望吗？”
